Reproduced input-boundary hang on the current PR head `0d2de720fc38b285e2e63463487b077e2d601256`: a named-pipe plan blocks before the diagnostic budgets or typed refusal can run.

**Evidence and reproduction**
- Tested with Node v24.19.0 on Linux, in an isolated synthetic directory, using the exact added `diagnostic-plans.ts` bytes verified against its Git blob SHA. No tracker, credentials, provider calls, or production state were used.
- Create a FIFO with no writer: `mkfifo synthetic-plan.fifo`.
- Import `readDiagnosticPlan` from that exact module and call `await readDiagnosticPlan("synthetic-plan.fifo")` in a separate Node process.
- The call produced no result/refusal and remained blocked until an external 2-second subprocess timeout terminated it (2.007 s observed). This is an SDK-module reproduction, not an installed CLI or whole-release certification.

**Static cause and CLI impact**
[`readDiagnosticPlan`](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/blob/0d2de720fc38b285e2e63463487b077e2d601256/diagnostic-plans.ts) calls `open(path, "r")` without nonblocking flags or a regular-file check. Opening a FIFO without a writer waits before the subsequent 16 KiB buffer limit matters. [The CLI adapter](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/blob/0d2de720fc38b285e2e63463487b077e2d601256/index.ts) awaits that reader before calling `executeDiagnosticPlan`, so its shared time budget cannot bound this input stage. CLI impact is established statically, not via a live command run.

**Expected / source goal**
The [feature record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/blob/0d2de720fc38b285e2e63463487b077e2d601256/.agents/pm/features/ops-diagnostic-plans.toon) calls for explicit resource budgets and typed refusals/remedies; the reader documents a bounded review artifact. An unsupported non-regular input should promptly return the existing sanitized `invalid_plan` refusal rather than leave an agent indefinitely waiting. No probe should launch and no tracker should change.

**Acceptance / regression**
Add a bounded subprocess regression using a FIFO with no writer, and reject non-regular inputs before any blocking read. Preserve valid regular JSON plans, malformed/oversized-file refusals, the 16 KiB ceiling, and scope/selection validation. Keep a deadline on the regression itself so a future regression cannot hang CI. This finding does not claim that the probe-dispatch budget enforcement itself failed.

Follow-up owner after PR194 merged unchanged. Original independently reproduced evidence: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/pull/194#issuecomment-6370990685 . All194 all-status issue/PR records and canonical feature were checked before that comment; refreshed all-status recent records after merge show no separate open owner. Creating this bug so the regression remains actionable rather than only in a closed PR.
